description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Featured' module controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It defines a class that manages the display and manipulation of the 'Featured' module within the administration panel, including functions for viewing, saving, and retrieving module data.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: The controller class for managing the Featured module in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main view for editing the Featured module, including loading language resources, setting breadcrumbs, retrieving module info, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration of the Featured module, including permission checks, validation, saving new or existing module data, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for displaying the featured module configuration page. Loads language, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumbs, loads module data if editing, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save or update the featured module settings. Checks permissions, validates input, interacts with the model to save data, and returns a JSON response.
